svg.title: 1899 · Manufacturing in the statistical South
svg.desc: Regional census shares; modern state boundaries provide orientation only.
svg.text: Regional census shares; modern state boundaries provide orientation only.
South13: AL AR FL GA KY LA MS NC OK SC TN TX VA. Fixed BLS statistical region, not the Confederacy.
Values belong to the region, not individual states. Rest of US is not synonymous with North. Ratio is not productivity.
Source: BLS Bulletin 898 (1947), table 2, printed p.7 / PDF p.13. Nominal gross product value, not value added.
